planets.name: TOI-4479 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4479 with a 1.16-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-4479 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-4479. Its orbit and size follow Esparza-Borges et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
